support.guideSongsStepFour: Nigba service, ṣí Worship tab ninu dock ki o click section tí o fẹ́ fi han.
support.guideMediaIntro: Lo eyi fun images, videos, countdown screens, ati background changes lori presentation output.

support.guideMediaStepThree: Lo backgrounds fun Bible ati Worship slides nigba tí o fẹ́ text lori image, color, tàbí video.
support.guideMediaStepFour: Lo countdowns ṣaaju service tàbí nigba transitions, lẹ́yìn náà stop tàbí replace wọn nigba tí o ṣetan.
support.guidePrepareIntro: Ṣe checks wọnyi ṣaaju ki eniyan to de ki service flow ṣetan, ki volunteers ma ṣe yara kiri.

supportExtended.faq1Question: Báwo ni mo ṣe so kọ̀ǹpútà tuntun tàbí iboju ìfihàn pọ̀?
supportExtended.faq1Answer: Fi app desktop MakeChurchEazy sori ẹrọ, wọlé, lẹ́yìn náà ṣí Devices ninu dashboard lati so kọ̀ǹpútà pọ̀. Bí o kò bá lo OBS, da link ìfihàn kọ lati presentation mode ki o ṣí i lori iboju tí o fẹ́ lo.

supportExtended.faq3Answer: Ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ ìfihàn le ṣiṣẹ́ ni agbegbe lẹ́yìn tí orin, Bible versions, media, ati themes ba ti ṣetan. Intanẹẹti nilo fun wọlé, sync, downloads, updates, AI tools, ati billing.
supportExtended.faq4Question: Báwo ni mo ṣe yí plan mi padà?
supportExtended.faq4Answer: Lọ si Subscription > Plans lati fi Free, Basic, ati Growth wé ara wọn. Upgrade yoo ṣí limits ati credits ti plan naa lẹ́yìn tí payment ba jẹ́risi.
